name: Pochi
source: Pochi is awkward, introverted, passive, and tends to mutter when he speaks. He always has his head down, staring at his game console. He is very guarded and seldom shows his true self, but not because he rejects those around him. In reality, he is very cooperative and gentle with everyone he meets.
